# Anamnesis Film (아남네시스필름)

> Anamnesis Film is an independent art film studio based in Seoul. We make films that trace how the past lives on in personal and collective memory. Founded in 2012. Contact: filmanamnesis@gmail.com.

Films in development or production are looking for partners: see each film page for what it needs.

## Films

- [A Prayer Carried toward the Altar](https://anamnesisfilm.com/prayer.html) (어느 신학생의 기도): Feature documentary, 2027, expected, dir. Changmin Lee. A handwritten prayer brings to light the lives of two Korean seminarians who died before they could become priests, asking what endures of a calling neither lived to fulfill.
- [The Silence of the Sirens](https://anamnesisfilm.com/sirens.html) (세이렌의 침묵): Hybrid documentary, 2028, expected, dir. Changmin Lee. The Silence of the Sirens, a hybrid documentary in development by Changmin Lee, looking for co-producers.
- [Hydrangea](https://anamnesisfilm.com/hydrangea.html) (수국): Feature documentary, 2026, dir. Soha Hiroyama-Park. Hydrangea, a feature documentary by Soha Hiroyama-Park. Korean Feature Competition, DMZ International Documentary Film Festival 2026.
- [A Benedictine Abbot’s Challenge and Hope](https://anamnesisfilm.com/abbot.html) (팜보 아빠스의 도전과 희망): Television documentary, 2020, dir. Changmin Lee. A television documentary by Changmin Lee about a Benedictine abbey in Mvimwa, Tanzania, and the villages around it.
- [Dear Elephant](https://anamnesisfilm.com/elephant.html) (디어 엘리펀드): Short documentary, 2019, dir. Changmin Lee. A short documentary by Changmin Lee about Lee Keongson, a Korean film director who settled in Thailand.
- [The Outcry of the People](https://anamnesisfilm.com/outcry.html) (함성들): Short documentary, 2017, dir. Changmin Lee. A short documentary by Changmin Lee, from the omnibus documentary Candle in the Wave, filmed outside South Korea’s National Assembly on the day of the 2016 impeachment vote.
- [Burmese on the Roof](https://anamnesisfilm.com/burmese.html) (옥상 위에 버마): Feature documentary, 2016, dir. Hyunjin Oh, Duhyun Ko. A feature documentary by Hyunjin Oh and Duhyun Ko about three Burmese migrant workers living on a rooftop in Korea.
- [Traces of Poverty](https://anamnesisfilm.com/traces.html) (가난의 경로): Documentary series, 2015–2016, dir. Changmin Lee. A documentary series by Changmin Lee, made with Hankyoreh 21, about residents of single-room lodgings in Seoul’s Dongja-dong facing eviction.
- [Dance, Full of Sound and Fury](https://anamnesisfilm.com/dance.html) (춤): Short experimental film, 2015, dir. Minseok Jo. Dance, Full of Sound and Fury, a short experimental film by Minseok Jo on American cinema as motion-spectacle and ideology.
- [Memories of a Photographer](https://anamnesisfilm.com/photographer.html) (어느 사진가의 기억): Feature documentary, 2014, dir. Changmin Lee. A feature documentary by Changmin Lee about the late photographer Kim Young-soo and what a photograph can preserve.

- Minseok Jo: Director, Producer, Writer
- Soha Hiroyama-Park: Director, Cinematographer
